messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — SonarCloud wants to close the POC this week. They submitted an Order Form but legal flagged signer routing and an invoice exception. Can we align?
Omar (Solutions Eng): Quick context: POC usage credits $12,500, estimated paid services on first invoice $62,000. Customer requests single signer but also wants the billing contact to approve invoices > $50k before payment terms apply.
Rina (Legal): We proposed two small additions: 1) a clause in the Order Form footer that states billing approvals required for invoices over $50k and 2) MSA exhibit reference so SLA is incorporated by reference.
Trevor (Finance): If invoice amount >= 50,000 we require an invoice-approval step from the customer's billing contact. For Redwood internal process, any committed ARR >= $50k needs finance signatory. We prefer the DocuSign envelope to route to finance@redwood.com when order_total >= 50000.
Maya (AE): Can we add a visible checkbox on the OF: "Customer confirms billing contact and accepts invoice approval flow for amounts >= $50,000"? Customer legal wants explicit acceptance.
Rina (Legal): Yes — add that exact checkbox text. Also suggest adding: "This Order Form incorporates by reference the Master Services Agreement, Data Processing Addendum, and Service Level Agreement attached as Exhibit A." Keep it concise.
Omar (Solutions Eng): For the DocuSign template, we can do an envelope conditional rule. Example snippet we use in templates: 
```
// DocuSign conditional routing example
{
  "envelope": {
    "routing": [
      { "condition": "order_total >= 50000", "recipient": "finance@redwood.com", "role": "Finance Signatory" },
      { "condition": "order_total < 50000", "recipient": "ae@redwood.com", "role": "Account Executive" }
    ]
  }
}
```
Maya (AE): Omar — can you spin up a draft OF in staging with that rule and the checkbox? I can send to customer once legal approves the exact wording.
Trevor (Finance): Also confirm payment terms: default Net-45. If customer asks Net-60, they must submit a credit exception form. That needs Finance approval. We should add a clause in the order form notes: "Net terms default to Net-45 unless pre-approved by Redwood Finance."
Rina (Legal): Agreed. Also, POC IP carveout: customer wants retention of POC deliverables. We can add a short POC Addendum paragraph: "For the avoidance of doubt, Customer retains ownership of artifacts produced solely by Customer during the POC. Redwood retains pre-existing IP and models." Will send final wording.
docsign-bot: Template v4.0 uploaded to staging at 2026-03-22T09:03:12Z. Routing rules preview available.
Maya (AE): Thanks bot. Two asks before I send: 1) final MSA/DPA redline link 2) finance signatory email to bake into template (single address).
Rina (Legal): Uploading redlines to the deals folder now. Link: [shared drive link] (I'll DM the exact path).
Trevor (Finance): Use accounts-payable@redwood.com as the finance signatory address for now. If this deal closes I'll update to the approver's personal email.
Maya (AE): Perfect. Target: get template set + legal text done by tomorrow EOD. Customer wants signature next week.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll provision the POC credits and drop the POC expiry date into the order form notes as: "POC expires 2026-04-05; unused trial credits expire on termination of POC."
Rina (Legal): Will finalize redlines and POC addendum by COB tomorrow.
Trevor (Finance): I'll queue pre-approval on Net-45 and keep an eye if they request Net-60.
Maya (AE): Great teamwork — will follow up in a quick huddle tomorrow AM if needed :thumbsup:
